snippet.title: Tekken 7 - Fahkumran & Cave of Enlightenment Trailer | PS4
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP0700-CUSA05972_00-TK7SEASONPASS003

There are no ornate moves in Muay Thai, only pure unadulterated destruction; so as Fahkumram joins the roster of playable characters in TEKKEN 7, all existing characters should be on notice! 

Along with Fahkumram, there will also be a new stage from which to destroy or be destroyed in as the Cave of Enlightenment opens itself to players seeking enlightenment in the form of delivering a satisfying beat down. 

Fahkumram and the Cave of Enlightenment will be available for download on March 24th for PS4
